lines.text: Many learners say: I have a new bag. Do you like?
Better: I have a new bag. Do you like it?
Do you like it? This song is nice. Do you like it?

data.wrong: I have a new bag. Do you like?
data.right: I have a new bag. Do you like it?

native.tip: हिंदी में “तुम्हें पसंद है?” बिना “इसे” के पूरा लगता है; अंग्रेज़ी में like के बाद चीज़ का नाम या it ज़रूर बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I have a new bag. Do you like?” 😅 सही रूप है “I have a new bag. Do you like it?” क्योंकि like के बाद चीज़ का नाम या it लगाना ज़रूरी है। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर है “Do you like it?” इसे ज़ोर से बोलकर दोहराइए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners drop it after like, but English needs a word after like.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I have a new bag. Do you like?” 😅 The right way is “I have a new bag. Do you like it?” This is right because like needs a word after it, like it. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
